column1: # MosoFin skill explainers — tracker. One row per skill; this file is the source of truth for the site.

column10: summary
Checks that what Stripe, Square or PayPal says you were paid matches your books, and catches revenue recorded net of processor fees.
column11: Plain page cites Stripe, Square, PayPal and the IRS; learn page adds IFRS 10.

column10: Use this skill whenever the user wants to book period-end accruals or deferrals from their Mosofin workspace, beyond AP-specific accruals.

Use this skill whenever the user wants to identify and book period-end AP accruals from their Mosofin workspace — invoices not yet received for services/goods already delivered, or goods received not yet invoiced (GRNI).
Use this skill whenever the user wants an accounts payable aging analysis, a payment run, or vendor payment prioritization from their Mosofin workspace.

Use the confirmed Mosofin workspace and its connected accounting datasource to pull live A/R, build and reconcile an aging, prioritize collections, calculate receivables metrics, and draft review-only reminders.
Use this skill whenever the user wants to reconcile balance sheet accounts to supporting subledgers or external documents, working from their Mosofin workspace.
Proves your bank statement and your books differ only for reasons you can name (timing, fees, bounced items) and finds what is left over.
column11: Plain page cites the FDIC, IRS, CFPB, NAUPA, GAO, Intuit and Stripe; learn page adds IFRS 10. Anatomy page: all 4 audit findings fixed on main (79f7a93, 2197ec8); skill now in card format.

column10: Use this skill whenever the user wants to compare actual results to budget or forecast and explain the variances, working from their Mosofin workspace.
Use this skill whenever the user wants to apply customer payments to open invoices, working from their Mosofin workspace.
Use this skill whenever the user wants a short-term cash flow forecast from their Mosofin workspace — classically a 13-week direct cash forecast for liquidity management.
Use this skill whenever the user wants to prepare closing entries, lock the books for a fiscal period, or produce / audit a trial balance from their Mosofin workspace.
Ties the company card statement to your books, matches receipts to charges, and lists what is missing, personal, duplicated or in the wrong account.
column11: Plain and learn pages cite the IRS, HMRC, the CFPB, Intuit, ACFE and IFRS 10. Both audit findings fixed in the card-format split of 25 Oct; see the anatomy page.

column10: Use this skill whenever the user wants to process a credit memo, customer refund, vendor credit, or sales return from their Mosofin workspace.
Use this skill whenever the user wants to generate customer invoices, draft invoice templates, validate invoice content, or build batched invoices from their Mosofin workspace.
Use this skill whenever the user wants to detect duplicate or fraudulent invoices in AP from their Mosofin workspace.
Use this skill whenever the user wants to process, review, or post employee expense reports against their Mosofin workspace.
Use this skill whenever the user wants to build a complete set of financial statements from their Mosofin workspace — Balance Sheet, Income Statement, and Statement of Cash Flows, with comparatives.

Use this skill whenever the user wants to maintain a fixed asset register, compute depreciation, capitalize new acquisitions, dispose of assets, or reconcile FA to the GL from their Mosofin workspace.
Use this skill whenever the user wants to assign GL account codes, expense categories, or tax codes to transactions in their Mosofin workspace.
Use this skill whenever the user wants to reconcile inventory subledger or physical counts to the GL using their Mosofin workspace.
Use this skill whenever the user uploads a vendor invoice (PDF, image, or scanned doc) and wants structured data extracted, validated against their Mosofin workspace.
Use this skill whenever the user wants to construct, format, or validate a journal entry against their Mosofin workspace.
Use this skill whenever the user wants to review journal entries for risk, propriety, or anomalies from their Mosofin workspace — a control/audit lens on JEs.
Use this skill whenever the user wants to plan, run, or audit a monthly close against their Mosofin workspace.
Use this skill whenever the user wants to reconcile payroll clearing, payroll suspense, payroll liability, or any payroll-related control account against their Mosofin workspace.
Use this skill whenever the user wants to build the journal entries that record payroll in the general ledger, against their Mosofin workspace.

Use this skill whenever the user wants to reconcile payroll against their Mosofin workspace — payroll register to GL, payroll to bank, payroll liabilities to amounts remitted, or quarter/year-end payroll tie-outs.
Use this skill whenever the user wants to build, maintain, or audit a prepaid expense amortization schedule against a connected Mosofin workspace.

Use this skill whenever the user wants to design, schedule, or validate recurring transactions against a connected Mosofin workspace — recurring journal entries, recurring bills, recurring invoices, or subscription billing schedules.
Checks that what you ordered, what arrived and what the supplier billed agree, line by line, before anything is paid, and says which of the three it had.
column11: Plain and learn pages cite the FAR, ACFE, GAO, IFRS, Intuit and NY Tax. Anatomy page: all three audit findings fixed on main (4d5637c, 9882a07, 526d8bf); skill now in card format.
